definitions: A type of aquatic or subterranean fairy or goblin in Orcadian and Shetlandic folklore, often depicted as malevolent.
In some fantasy role-playing games and literature, a member of a fictional race of dark-skinned elves, typically evil and dwelling in the Underdark.
examples: The old woman warned of the drow lurking in the loch.
The adventurers encountered a drow patrol in the cavern.
She read a story about a drow who stole children.
